title: Theo and the Terminal
author: Isandro Eastwick
blurb: Isandro Montrose, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
